metadata.title: Walker Lake and Jura: classic geostatistics datasets as CSV
metadata.description:
Two classic geostatistics datasets converted to CSV from the R package gstat, with a README per dataset documenting every file and column and suggesting exercises. Compiled for teaching; the data belong to their original authors.

  • walker-lake: 470 clustered samples and the 78 000-node exhaustive truth (Isaaks & Srivastava, 1989, An Introduction to Applied Geostatistics, Oxford University Press).
  • jura: seven metals in topsoil with rock and land-use covariates and 100 validation points (Goovaerts, 1997, Geostatistics for Natural Resources Evaluation, Oxford University Press; Atteia et al., 1994; Webster et al., 1994).

Distributed in gstat under GPL (>= 2); this copy is shared under the same license.
